database_dir.description: Directory where the ht://Dig database files are stored.

start_url.description: The starting URL for the crawler. Can be multiple URLs separated by whitespace.

maintainer.description: Email address sent in the User-Agent string to identify the robot maintainer.

max_head_length.description: Maximum length of the HTTP headers to store in the index.

max_doc_size.description: Maximum size in bytes of documents to index.

no_excerpt_show_top.description: Whether to show the top of the document if exact search words are not found in the stored excerpt.

search_algorithm.description: Search algorithms and their weights used for ranking results.
